who.title: Public Health & Corrections
who.desc: Correctional healthcare runs on high patient turnover, custody constraints, and some of the heaviest audit and accreditation scrutiny in medicine — NCCHC, ACA, state DOC, and court-monitored consent decrees all watching the same chart. Murphi.ai gives your EHR platform ambient AI documentation, voice-to-text dictation, translation, and behavior & risk intelligence — embeddable into your existing screens and workflows without a platform rebuild.

stats.title: What Correctional Healthcare Platforms Gain
stats.sub: Correctional EHRs carry a workload most healthcare software never sees — intake screening on every booking, documentation across remote housing units, and records that have to hold up to NCCHC, ACA, and state DOC audits at once.

ambient.title: Custody Encounter Voice to Compliant Note — Before the Next Call
ambient.sub: Murphi.ai listens during the intake screening, sick call, or chronic care encounter and generates structured notes in the format your EHR and DOC contract require. Clinicians review and approve — one tap to write to EHR.

note.text: Patient booked into facility, reports no acute complaints. Denies chest pain, SOB, or active withdrawal symptoms. Reports history of hypertension, currently on lisinopril.
Vitals stable, BP 128/82. Alert and oriented x4. No visible signs of trauma or acute distress.
Stable for general population housing. Chronic care follow-up required for hypertension.
Continue home medication pending formulary review. Schedule chronic care clinic within 14 days.

features.name: Voice-to-Text Dictation

features.name: AI Rewrite

features.name: Clinical Summaries
features.desc: Auto-generated chart summaries at transfer, shift change, or court appearance — condensing the full record into what the next clinician needs.

features.name: Handwriting-to-Text
features.desc: Converts handwritten encounter notes and intake forms into structured digital text using AI-powered recognition.

features.name: Assessment Auto-Population

features.name: Patient Summary Reading

features.name: Pre-Encounter Clinical Brief

features.name: Chronic Care Plan Generation
features.desc: Drafts individualized chronic care plans from intake assessment, diagnosis, and encounter goals — structured for audit and accreditation review.

features.name: Clinical Documentation Improvement (CDI)
features.desc: Reviews encounter notes for specificity, completeness, and defensibility — prompting clinicians to add supporting detail before finalization.

features.name: Document Comparison
features.desc: Compares two versions of a clinical document — care plans, encounter notes, or assessments — and highlights changes for review.

features.name: Referral Document Scrubbing
features.desc: Extracts and validates clinical information from inbound transfer and referral records — auto-populating the EHR on intake.

features.name: Behavior Pattern Detection
features.desc: Surfaces patterns across encounters — repeat sick call visits, medication refusals, escalating complaints — that might otherwise stay buried in individual notes.

features.name: Risk Behavior Flagging
features.desc: Flags risk indicators drawn from clinical notes — self-harm language, withdrawal signs, aggression history — to support classification and housing decisions.

features.name: Withdrawal Risk Scoring
features.desc: Auto-captures COWS/CIWA-style withdrawal indicators from the encounter and scores them alongside the note.

features.name: Classification & Housing Support Brief
features.desc: Compiles the clinical and behavioral record into a brief that supports — never replaces — custody classification and housing decisions.

features.name: Segregation / Restrictive Housing Check Documentation
features.desc: Structures periodic segregation and restrictive housing health checks into a consistent, audit-ready format.

features.name: Coding & Claims Agent
features.desc: Reviews approved notes, suggests CPT and ICD-10 codes with confidence scores, and checks documentation before claim submission.

features.name: Eligibility Check at Booking & Release
features.desc: Verifies Medicaid suspension/reinstatement status at intake and release, surfacing gaps for billing staff to act on.

features.name: AI Audit Trail & Reporting
features.desc: Logs every AI action, human review decision, edit, and approval with timestamp, user, and confidence score — exportable for audits.

features.name: Note Quality Checker
features.desc: Reviews completed encounter notes for clinical specificity and audit-readiness before finalization.

features.name: Informed Consent Documentation Check
features.desc: Verifies that informed consent, HIPAA notice, and release of information documentation is complete and current.

features.name: NCCHC / ACA Accreditation Check
features.desc: Reviews documentation for alignment with NCCHC and ACA correctional healthcare accreditation standards — flagging gaps before audits.

features.name: 42 CFR Part 2 Flag & Workflow
features.desc: Identifies SUD-related documentation and applies heightened access controls aligned to 42 CFR Part 2.

features.name: Supervision & Co-Signature Workflow
features.desc: Routes notes from provisionally licensed clinicians to supervisors for mandatory co-signature — with deadline tracking.

features.name: Medication Administration Exception Detection
features.desc: Reviews eMAR/MedPass documentation against protocol in real time — flagging missed doses, refusal patterns, and non-formulary gaps before they surface as audit findings.

features.name: TB/PPD & Immunization Tracking Compliance
features.desc: Confirms TB screening and immunization documentation is complete and current against facility and state DOC requirements.

features.name: Human Review & Approval Workflow
features.desc: Every AI-generated output passes through clinician review before entering the EHR record — with full edit capability.

Murphi.ai surfaces it in the same session, feeding classification and housing decisions instead of a retrospective chart review.
